Thanks Priya / Sam — I pulled the traces and started tailing the serving logs for prod-fintech-infer-01. Preliminary notes:

- We are seeing a pattern consistent with KV cache churn — rw-open-3b-v2 uses a larger key distribution (different tokenizer alignment) that increases KV writes for these request shapes.
- p50 remains ~180-250ms; p95 ~320-450ms; p99 legs spike and sometimes show 1.2–1.5s at peak.
- Error rate correlates with Gemma worker OOM retries on node gpu-3 (we’re seeing retries and backpressure).

Immediate mitigation options (ranked):
1) Roll back the routing for prod-fintech-infer-01 to rw-open-3b (v1) — fast and low-risk.
2) Temporarily restrict sequence length/auto-batching for the endpoint (mitigates cost but impacts throughput).
3) Scale dedicated pool for the endpoint (takes longer; we have limited spare GPU headroom).

Rollback trigger proposal (for this customer and similar critical tenants):
- Automated rollback if p99 > 700ms sustained longer than 30 minutes AND 5xx rate > 0.5%.

I’ve attached a short trace bundle (trace_bundle_0309.tar.gz) and the rollback_runbook.pdf with steps I recommend for a manual rollback and postmortem checklist.

If you want, I can action manual rollback now; will need explicit approval from Markus or Lauren for SLA/credit exceptions.

— Karthik
